claims.claim: 同一個 IP 對 `/products` 連續送 1000 個請求：限流器的桶子容量是 10、每秒補 5 個。通過的請求數不超過「容量加這段時間補的數量」，至少有容量那麼多，其餘回 429，而且每個 429 都帶 `Retry-After`。測試 `TestFloodFromOneIPIsMostlyRejected` 起真的 HTTP server，走真的 TCP 驗證。
claims.claim_en: One IP sends 1000 requests to `/products`; the limiter's bucket holds 10 tokens and refills 5 per second. The passed requests never exceed capacity plus what refilled meanwhile, are at least the capacity, and the rest get 429, each with `Retry-After`. The test `TestFloodFromOneIPIsMostlyRejected` starts a real HTTP server over real TCP.

claims.claim: tag `ep03` 的程式碼沒有限流，也沒有 session：`internal/handler/middleware.go`、`internal/platform/ratelimit/ratelimit.go`、`internal/platform/session/memory.go` 都不存在。這三個原始碼檔是這一章新增的。
claims.claim_en: The code at tag `ep03` has no rate limiting and no session: `internal/handler/middleware.go`, `internal/platform/ratelimit/ratelimit.go` and `internal/platform/session/memory.go` do not exist. This chapter adds all three source files.

claims.claim: `Recover`、`RateLimit`、`Session` 三個 middleware 的型別都是 `func(http.Handler) http.Handler`：收一個 handler，回傳一個 handler。`handler.New` 用 chi 的 `r.Use` 串起來，順序是 `RequestLog`、`Recover`，然後是呼叫端傳入的 middleware。測試 `TestChainOrder` 證明請求依序進去、回應依相反順序出來：`first in, second in, second out, first out`。
claims.claim_en: `Recover`, `RateLimit` and `Session` each return `func(http.Handler) http.Handler`: they take a handler and return a handler. `handler.New` chains them with chi's `r.Use` in this order: `RequestLog`, `Recover`, then the middleware the caller passes. The test `TestChainOrder` proves requests go in order and responses come out in reverse: `first in, second in, second out, first out`.

checks.pattern: func RateLimit\(limiter Limiter, logger \*slog\.Logger\) func\(http\.Handler\) http\.Handler \{
func Session\(store SessionStore, ttl time\.Duration, logger \*slog\.Logger\) func\(http\.Handler\) http\.Handler \{

claims.claim: `RateLimit` 在限流器回報用完額度時，回 429 與 `api.Error`（code 是 `rate_limited`），加上 `Retry-After` 標頭，然後 `return`，不呼叫 `next`。`Retry-After` 的秒數無條件進位，最少是 1 秒。測試 `TestRateLimit` 的案例 `blocked`（0.3 秒進位成 1）與 `retry-after rounds up`（2.1 秒進位成 3）都通過。
claims.claim_en: When the limiter reports the quota used up, `RateLimit` replies 429 with an `api.Error` (code `rate_limited`) and a `Retry-After` header, then returns without calling `next`. The `Retry-After` seconds round up and are at least 1. The `TestRateLimit` cases `blocked` (0.3 s rounds up to 1) and `retry-after rounds up` (2.1 s rounds up to 3) pass.

checks.pattern:
if !ok \{
				secs := int\(math\.Ceil\(retryAfter\.Seconds\(\)\)\)
				w\.Header\(\)\.Set\("Retry-After", strconv\.Itoa\(max\(secs, 1\)\)\)
				writeJSON\(w, logger, http\.StatusTooManyRequests, api\.Error\{Code: "rate_limited", Message: "too many requests"\}\)
				return
return // not calling next is how a middleware says "stop here"\n\t\t\t\}\n\t\t\tnext\.ServeHTTP\(w, r\)

claims.claim: 限流的 key 是 `RemoteAddr` 用 `net.SplitHostPort` 取出的主機位址，不含埠號；程式碼沒有讀 `X-Forwarded-For` 標頭。測試 `TestRateLimit` 的案例 `allowed` 與 `ipv6 remote address` 檢查 key 不含埠號，案例 `x-forwarded-for is ignored` 送出不同的 `X-Forwarded-For`，限流器收到的 key 仍然是 `RemoteAddr` 的主機位址。
claims.claim_en: The limiter's key is the host part of `RemoteAddr`, taken with `net.SplitHostPort`, without the port; no code reads the `X-Forwarded-For` header. The `TestRateLimit` cases `allowed` and `ipv6 remote address` check that the key has no port, and the case `x-forwarded-for is ignored` sends a different `X-Forwarded-For` and the limiter still receives the host part of `RemoteAddr` as its key.

claims.claim: 限流器是 token bucket：每個 key 一個桶子，桶子有容量上限；每次經過的時間乘以補充速率，補進令牌，但不超過容量；每次請求拿走 1 個令牌。`cmd/api/main.go` 設定每個 IP 每秒補 10 個、容量 20。測試 `TestAllow` 的 4 個案例都通過。
claims.claim_en: The limiter is a token bucket: one bucket per key with a capacity; elapsed time times the refill rate is added as tokens, never above the capacity; each request takes 1 token. `cmd/api/main.go` sets 10 tokens per second and a capacity of 20 per IP. All 4 cases of the test `TestAllow` pass.

claims.claim: `Limiter` 用 `sync.Mutex` 保護存桶子的 map：`Allow` 一進來就 `Lock`，並用 `defer` 解鎖。測試 `TestLimiterHoldsUnderConcurrency` 用 20 個 goroutine、每個送 25 個請求，通過的數量沒有超過上限。
claims.claim_en: `Limiter` guards the map of buckets with a `sync.Mutex`: `Allow` locks on entry and unlocks with `defer`. The test `TestLimiterHoldsUnderConcurrency` uses 20 goroutines sending 25 requests each, and the number of passed requests stays within the limit.

checks.pattern: func \(l \*Limiter\) Allow\(key string\) \(ok bool, retryAfter time\.Duration\) \{\n\tl\.mu\.Lock\(\)\n\tdefer l\.mu\.Unlock\(\)

claims.claim: `sweep` 會刪掉閒置到桶子已經補滿的 key，沒有這一步，map 裡的桶子只增不減。時鐘是注入的：`Limiter` 有一個 `now` 函式欄位，測試用 `fakeClock` 手動往前撥，這個 tag 所有 `_test.go` 檔裡都沒有 `time.Sleep`。測試 `TestSweepDropsIdleKeys` 證明閒置的 key 被刪掉。
claims.claim_en: `sweep` deletes keys idle long enough for their bucket to be full again; without it the map of buckets only grows. The clock is injected: `Limiter` has a `now` function field, tests move a `fakeClock` forward by hand, and no `_test.go` file at this tag contains `time.Sleep`. The test `TestSweepDropsIdleKeys` proves idle keys are deleted.

claims.claim: `cmd/api/main.go` 把 `RateLimit` 放在 `Session` 前面，所以被限流擋下的請求到不了 session store。測試 `TestFloodFromOneIPIsMostlyRejected` 數 `Create` 被呼叫幾次：建立的 session 數不超過通過的請求數。
claims.claim_en: `cmd/api/main.go` places `RateLimit` before `Session`, so a request the limiter rejects never reaches the session store. The test `TestFloodFromOneIPIsMostlyRejected` counts `Create` calls: the sessions created never exceed the requests that passed.

claims.claim: session id 是 16 個位元組（128 位元）的隨機數，來自 `crypto/rand`，程式碼沒有用 `math/rand`。cookie 設 `HttpOnly` 與 `SameSite=Lax`。`Session` 用 `context.WithValue` 把 id 放進請求的 context，key 是不匯出的型別 `ctxKey`。測試 `TestSessionCookieSticks` 證明瀏覽器連續 3 次請求，只有第 1 次回應帶 `Set-Cookie`。
claims.claim_en: A session id is 16 random bytes (128 bits) from `crypto/rand`; the code does not use `math/rand`. The cookie sets `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Lax`. `Session` puts the id on the request context with `context.WithValue`, under the unexported key type `ctxKey`. The test `TestSessionCookieSticks` proves that across 3 requests from one browser only the first response carries `Set-Cookie`.

claims.claim: `handler` 套件宣告 `SessionStore` 介面，只有 `Create` 和 `Exists` 兩個方法。這一章的實作是 `session.Memory`：session 存在行程記憶體的 map 裡，`cmd/api/main.go` 呼叫 `session.NewMemory`。測試 `TestSession` 的 4 個案例都通過：沒有 cookie 就建立 session、認得的 cookie 沿用、不認得的 cookie 換成新的、store 失敗回 500。
claims.claim_en: The `handler` package declares the `SessionStore` interface with exactly two methods, `Create` and `Exists`. This chapter's implementation is `session.Memory`: sessions live in a map in process memory, and `cmd/api/main.go` calls `session.NewMemory`. All 4 cases of the test `TestSession` pass: no cookie creates a session, a known cookie is reused, an unknown cookie is replaced, a store failure is a 500.

claims.claim: `Recover` 用 `defer` 加 `recover` 攔下後面 handler 的 panic，把 panic 的內容與堆疊寫進 log，回給客戶端的是 500 與固定的 `api.Error`（code `internal_error`，message `internal error`）。測試 `TestPanicInsideRouterIsAnAPIError` 證明。
claims.claim_en: `Recover` uses `defer` and `recover` to catch a panic in any later handler, writes the panic value and stack to the log, and sends the client a 500 with a fixed `api.Error` (code `internal_error`, message `internal error`). The test `TestPanicInsideRouterIsAnAPIError` proves it.

checks.text: writeJSON(w, logger, http.StatusInternalServerError, api.Error{Code: "internal_error", Message: "internal error"})

claims.claim: ASP.NET Core 用 `app.Use` 串 middleware，每個 middleware 呼叫 `next` 才會讓請求繼續往後；Java 的 Servlet Filter 呼叫 `chain.doFilter` 才會繼續。Go 的 middleware 呼叫 `next.ServeHTTP` 達到同樣的效果。
claims.claim_en: ASP.NET Core chains middleware with `app.Use`, and a middleware lets the request continue by calling `next`; a Java Servlet Filter continues by calling `chain.doFilter`. A Go middleware does the same by calling `next.ServeHTTP`.
